title: General Topology II
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the requirements in topology to limit the size of the object that is under consideration."
Separability is one of the requirements in topology to limit the size of the object that is under consideration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived from the course competencies and objectives."
The modules are derived from the course competencies and objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the central point which help to measure your achievement or success in the course."
The intended learning outcome(s) is the central point which help to measure your achievement or success in the course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an abstraction of metric spaces."
A topological space is an abstraction of metric spaces.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in algebraic topology to classify topological spaces."
Homotopy groups are used in algebraic topology to classify topological spaces.
